cases.title: Opening, next in the path with something in the comp: names the skill and the layers it would use

rubric.reason: The mentor names the recommended skill 'Pick the key type on purpose' and the two focus_layers 'Blink and Cut', then ends on 'Want to start there?'
The reply is two sentences: one skill, its reason ('the next step after Easing'), and the offer; it has no menu, no recital of the record, no tool or field talk, and no teaching.
'Pick the key type on purpose', 'Blink' and 'Cut' match the recommend_next result, and 'Easing' is a plain-words mention of the learned easing.basic in the record.
